description: This file contains utility functions for currency conversion, exchange rate retrieval, and gross margin calculation within the ERPNext accounting module.

methods.name: get_currency
methods.description: Returns currency information including company, company currency, presentation currency, and report date based on provided filters.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a monetary value from one currency to another on a specific date using exchange rates.

methods.name: get_rate_as_at
methods.description: Retrieves the exchange rate between two currencies as at a specific date, with memoization for efficiency.

methods.name: convert_to_presentation_currency
methods.description: Converts a list of General Ledger entries' debit and credit amounts to presentation currency based on currency info.

methods.name: get_appropriate_company
methods.description: Determines the appropriate company based on filters or defaults.

methods.name: get_invoiced_item_gross_margin
methods.description: Calculates the gross margin for an invoiced item, optionally including item data, using the GrossProfitGenerator.
